cases.title: TERMINATE stops running work everywhere
cases.when: A TERMINATE kill commits while sandboxes run on hosts and clients
then: Sandboxes killed; fencing tokens invalid; broker drops connections
Invocations end CANCELLED, or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN when an effect may have been sent
Queued tasks CANCELLED, running tasks CANCEL_REQUESTED

cases.title: STOP_NEW hides and refuses new work
then: Hidden from catalogs; new calls and admissions refused; running work continues

cases.title: A partitioned host cannot start new work
cases.when: A host is partitioned from Control when a kill commits, with and without selfTerminateOnControlLoss
then: No new admission, redemption or report
Without the setting: running work continues to its deadline
With it: running work terminates after the window

cases.title: Break-glass and Control down
then: Running work is bounded by deadline and selfTerminateOnControlLoss
After recovery the break-glass kill is pushed and acknowledged

cases.title: Acknowledgements record path and epoch
cases.when: A kill is delivered by push, check-in and poll to different components
then: control_kill_acks records the epoch and path; acks only move forward

cases.title: A kill invalidates the fencing token on every check
cases.when: After a kill, the host redeems a secret, the broker checks a capability, and the host reports progress

cases.title: Superseded kills leave the push set after acks or 30 days
cases.when: A recovery is acknowledged by all components, and another is not for 30 days
then: Both move to the archive; event rows remain

cases.title: A kill suspends the package version
cases.when: A package kill commits, then a reviewed recovery
then: Version SUSPENDED, then back to its previous state
